# Approved release policy — 2026-09-01

## authority
Status: approved. This policy is binding unless superseded by an approved amendment that explicitly identifies its scope.

## retention
Retain release evidence for 30 days.

## approvals
A human release owner must approve each production release. Automated preparation and verification may run before approval.

## release-window
Production releases may begin between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC on supported operating days.

## rollback
Keep at least two prior deployable application versions, with their compatible data recovery instructions.
